summary:
Iter 80 — E2E test of 4 features on shared FastAPI backend + web (React) + mobile (Expo web preview). All 8 backend pytest cases PASS; web + mobile UI flows PASS.

=== 1) GROUP DMs ✅ PASS (backend + web + mobile) ===
Backend (pytest 8/8 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_iter80_groups_follow_identity.py):
  • POST /messages/group rejects <2 members (400) and empty body (400).
  • POST /messages/group with participant_ids=[seed_alex, seed_marina] returns {is_group:true, title, participants: 3 uids, thread_id:'group_...'} — 200.
  • GET /messages/threads for marina lists the new group with is_group=true, unread=1, members=[3], title, last_message.
  • POST /messages/group/{tid} from marina inserts a message; jenn's thread unread goes 0→1.
  • GET /messages/{tid} returns both messages in order for a participant.
  • POST /messages/{tid}/read on group thread returns {ok:true, group:true} and unread resets to 0.
  • Non-participant (seed_jane) gets 403 on GET /messages/{tid}.
  • ROUTE ORDER: POST /messages/group returns is_group:true (not shadowed by /messages/{recipient_id}).
  • 1:1 DM regression: send + threads with unread + mark-read (marked>=1) all pass; 1:1 threads have no is_group flag.
WEB /messages (1440×900, jenn cookie): [data-testid=new-group-btn] opens [data-testid=new-group-modal]; group-search-input works (search by prefix — e.g. 'alex' returns seed_alex, 'salish' returns seed_marina). Note: /api/users/search matches prefix on first name token so 'marina' returns [] but 'salish' returns Marina — flagged as minor UX below. Selected Alex+Marina, filled group-title-input + group-message-input, tapped create-group-btn → 'Group chat started' toast + a new [data-testid=thread-group-<tid>] row appeared in sidebar (count went from 3→4), header shows title + member names (Jenn McDonald, Alex Rivera, Salish Marina Services). Send message via chat input works — text appears in the pane. Sender name / bubbles rendered as expected.
MOBILE /messages (390×844, jenn token localStorage): messages tab header [data-testid=new-group-btn] navigates to /messages/new. On that screen [data-testid=group-search-input | group-title-input | group-message-input | create-group-btn] all present. Search for alex + salish returned [data-testid=group-result-seed_alex] and group-result-seed_marina, both selectable. Tapping create-group-btn navigates to /messages/group_<hex>?name=...&group=1, showing the first message bubble ('hello from mobile expo') + 'Group chat started' toast. [data-testid=chat-input] + [data-testid=chat-send-btn] present; sending 'mobile follow-up' appears in the transcript. Back on /messages, the new group row shows in the list with [data-testid=thread-group-<tid>] (count = 4 groups + 1 direct = 5 rows).

=== 2) FOLLOW USERS ✅ PASS (backend + web + mobile) ===
Backend: GET /api/u/alexrivera returns {user:{user_id:'seed_alex',handle:'alexrivera',account_type:'sailor',...}, follower_count:int, following_count:int, is_following:bool, recent_posts:[...]}. POST /api/follows/seed_alex → {following:true, follower_count:base+1}; idempotent second POST keeps count at base+1; DELETE /api/follows/seed_alex → {following:false, follower_count:base}. Same follows collection is used for both org and person follows (the backend treats any user_id as a follow target).
WEB /u/alexrivera: [data-testid=handle-follow-btn] + [data-testid=handle-follow-counts] + [data-testid=handle-follower-count] all render. Click toggle: Follow (0) → Following (1) → Follow (0). Sailor pill + handle + Message button render alongside.
MOBILE /u/alexrivera: [data-testid=follow-user-btn] + [data-testid=profile-follower-count] render. Tap toggle: Follow (0) → Following (1) → Follow (0). Screen also shows follower/following stats and recent posts.

=== 3) MAP CLUSTERING WEB ✅ PASS ===
Web /events → tapped List/Map toggle → [data-testid=event-map] rendered with Leaflet tiles + 3 numbered cluster bubbles labelled '1' (Bellingham), '4' (Seattle area), '13' (Portland) — matches the 17 geocoded events. Zooming in with .leaflet-control-zoom-in split the clusters (marker count changed on zoom). Individual venue popups still open (map-event-<id> is created inside cluster child popups per code — verified in EventMap.jsx logic). This is the leaflet.markercluster behavior spec'd in the request.
MOBILE map clustering: intentionally NOT tested on Expo web preview per the request note — native react-native-maps clustering is device-only.

=== 4) ID VERIFICATION MOBILE ✅ PASS ===
Backend: POST /api/identity/session under the current sk_test_emergent Stripe key returns 409 with detail 'Stripe Identity isn't available yet — a real Stripe secret key with Identity enabled must be set as STRIPE_API_KEY.' (not a 500 — graceful).
MOBILE /profile: 'IDENTITY' section renders with [data-testid=verify-identity-row] ('Verify my identity — Get the ID Verified badge with Stripe Identity'). Tapping it kicks off POST /api/identity/session — the 409 is surfaced as a friendly red toast at the top: 'Stripe Identity isn't available yet — a real Stripe secret key with Identity enabled must be set as STRIPE_API_KEY.' No crash / no red screen. When user.identity_verified would be true, the code renders [data-testid=id-verified-row] instead (verified by static inspection — jenn is not verified so the verify row is what's visible).

=== 5) REGRESSION ✅ PASS ===
1:1 DM still works (regression test passes). Follow-org endpoints unchanged (iter79 seed_partner counts stable). Event map + filters still render. No console errors on either surface (only pre-existing deprecated shadow* warnings on Expo web).

issues: /api/users/search only matches the leading token of the name — 'marina' returns [], user must type 'salish' to find Salish Marina Services, and 'jane' returns [] where 'captain' works. This is not blocking (handle search '@alexrivera' also works) but is surprising UX for a group chat search box.

action_items: (Minor) Consider making /api/users/search substring-match anywhere in name (not just prefix on first token) so 'marina' finds 'Salish Marina Services' and 'jane' finds 'Captain Jane' in the group-DM composer. Handle-based search '@alexrivera' etc. already works, so this is non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: messaging_router.py: route order is intentional and correct — /messages/group and /messages/group/{tid} are declared BEFORE /messages/{recipient_id}, so FastAPI matches them first. Verified by test_route_order_group_not_shadowed. Good.

messaging_router.py list_threads() computes group unread with count_documents({thread_id, from_id:{$ne:me}, created_at:{$gt:reads[me]}}) — this correctly resets to 0 the moment /read is called, and never double-counts messages the caller sent. Clean.

messaging_router.py create_group() dedupes participant_ids (drops self, drops dupes) and caps at 20. Empty body is rejected (400). Notifications are fire-and-forget (try/except) so a notification-service failure won't fail the write. Good.

identity_router.py: catching stripe errors and remapping to a 409 with a human-friendly detail is the right pattern — the mobile UI already surfaces `detail` as a toast, so users on a test-Stripe deployment see 'Stripe Identity isn't available yet ...' instead of a stack trace. This is exactly the graceful path the request called for.

follows_router.py: the collection is called `follows` and its docs are {user_id, org_id} — but `org_id` is actually any user_id (sailor, pro, org). The naming is legacy-fine; both surfaces read `follower_count` / `following_count` / `is_following` off /api/u/{handle}, and follows/{id} POST/DELETE work for both people and orgs. No drift risk.

/api/users/search (community_router) appears to only match the FIRST NAME TOKEN as a prefix — 'salish' hits 'Salish Marina Services' but 'marina' does not. If this is Mongo text index with a $regex prefix, worth switching to a case-insensitive substring so 'marina' / 'jane' hit their expected users.

success_rate.frontend: web 3/3, mobile 3/3 (group DM, follow user, identity graceful-fail all pass)

Titles all start with 'TEST_iter80' or 'TEST iter80' for easy cleanup. No follows were left behind (all POSTs were paired with DELETEs in the test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: (a) Group DM route order matters — /messages/group and /messages/group/{tid} MUST stay before /messages/{recipient_id}. Regression test test_route_order_group_not_shadowed guards this. (b) Backend follows collection is used for BOTH person-follow and org-follow — GET /api/u/{handle} counts them together. (c) Mobile group compose is at /messages/new (not a modal); creating navigates to /messages/{tid}?group=1. (d) /api/users/search is prefix-on-first-token — if you need to find Marina in a search, type 'salish' or her handle; likewise 'captain' for Jane. (e) Identity 409 with sk_test_emergent is the EXPECTED path — do NOT treat it as a failure. Toast wording is 'Stripe Identity isn't available yet — a real Stripe secret key with Identity enabled must be set as STRIPE_API_KEY.' (f) Test data leftover: ~4 groups titled 'TEST iter80 …' / 'TEST_iter80 …' — safe to leave, will not affect production seeds. (g) seed_partner follower_count is now 2 (unchanged from iter79).
